PIPELINE-PROTOCOL: BRIDGE-WAKE-V1
BEGIN_TOOBA_TASK
Task-ID: TB-SHIPPING-INDEPENDENT-GROUP-SCHEDULE-145
Parent-Task: TB-SHIPPING-ONE-LEVEL-TABS-144
Channel: tooba-main
WorkerId: tooba-worker-01
AgentType: cursor
Repository: mrnikiemami-code/Tooba
Branch: main
Expected-Base-SHA: 5004a59af2f52525f0207216f86b2f4826fa5d7c
Program: TOOBA-SHIPPING-INDEPENDENT-SELLER-COMMITMENTS
Mode: BOUNDED_CONTRACT_GAP_AND_APPROVAL_WIREFRAME
Status-Target: PASS_OR_PARTIAL
Stop-State: STOP_FOR_ARCHITECT
Automatic-Next-Implementation-Task: NONE
Timebox: 45 MINUTES HARD; complete analysis and deliverables by minute 35, commit/report by minute 45. No loops, broad sweeps or service launches.

AUTHORITATIVE CONTRACTS — READ FIRST
docs/architecture/shipping/SHIPPING-GROUP-INDEPENDENT-DELIVERY-COMMITMENT.md
docs/architecture/checkout/SHIPPING-METHOD-GROUPING-UI-CONTRACT.md
docs/architecture/shipping/SHIPPING-ADMIN-FLAT-METHOD-CONTRACT.md
The first contract supersedes ANY old assumption that cart has one delivery date/time, or that equal service names collapse seller obligations.

OBJECTIVE
Produce an implementable, SOURCE-GROUNDED change map and approval-ready WIREFRAME for the NEW customer Shipping requirement, before altering application code. Separate independent per-seller/per-operational-group promises, even when both sellers select tipax:standard but one earliest date is +2 days and another +3 days. Each group must have its own eligible dates, time-window, fee, selected date/time and stable ShippingGroupId. Preserve storefront's existing appearance, cards, colors, RTL and responsive components. Do NOT modify Admin UX during this task; the flat-method Admin plan remains tracked separately.

MISSION A — PRECISE CODE GAP, NOT REPEATED ARCHITECTURAL INVENTORY
Trace the exact CURRENT files/functions/DTOs (and line ranges) for:

storefront-shipping.tsx and existing group horizon hook (intersection/one global date + time);
Shipping projection, StorefrontShippingGroupSelection/View, draft store, SaveSelectionAsync and ProjectAsync;
CartShippingGroupPlanner grouping invariant and server method eligibility/promise logic;
persisted CartShippingDraftGroup and accepted OrderShippingGroup scheduling fields and conversions;
Checkout projection/payment, Fulfillment handoff, admin method schedules and persisted timezone/slot authority.
For each necessary change, state owning module, precise function, minimal additive contract/schema implications, backward compatibility and exact risk. Establish whether existing DB groups already store per-group selected dates (if yes, avoid unnecessary migration), and distinguish individual per-group stored data from the CURRENT global UI/server selection. No speculation or fabricated endpoints.

MISSION B — APPROVAL-READY WIREFRAME / UX CONTRACT
Create docs/planning/shipping/SHIPPING-GROUP-SCHEDULE-WIREFRAME-145.md with a readable RTL textual wireframe and a concise component-state map for each shipment card:
Seller A / Tipax Standard / earliest 2 days / own item(s) / own date + time picker / own fee;
Seller B / Tipax Standard / earliest 3 days / own item(s) / own date + time picker / own fee.
Two SEPARATE cards and schedules despite IDENTICAL service name. Also include same seller with two methods and a case with same seller+method but incompatible promises/origin. Explicitly ban ANY global shared date selector and any cross-group intersection of date horizons. Reuse the real source-defined storefront design tokens/markup, do not suggest wholesale redesign.
Draft exact acceptance with independent changes, group-specific stale invalidation, back/refresh, Order/Payment/Fulfillment identity/slots, legacy single-group behavior.

MISSION C — FAST DEVELOPMENT PLAN, NOT NEW RESEARCH WAVES
Lay out at most THREE substantive implementation increments (owner-correct backend read/write and group schedule validation; frontend card schedule controls with backward compatibility; one scratch runtime proof), each <=45m, mandatory PASS/STOP. Identify trusted fixture needs for +2/+3-day same-method different-seller promise without inventing business rates, shipping-origin or dates.
Deliver short docs/planning/shipping/SHIPPING-GROUP-SCHEDULE-IMPLEMENTATION-145.md and minimal evidence/RESULT under docs/architecture/evidence/TB-SHIPPING-INDEPENDENT-GROUP-SCHEDULE-145/. Avoid long docs and redundant proofs. Commit and push normally, verify HEAD==origin/main, preserve unrelated dirty admin and evidence files, task receipt unstaged; no reset/stash/rebase/force push.
NO production activation, no shared :5088/:3000, tooba_alpha access, no local Host/frontend start/stop, no migrations, data writes or UI/CSS edits in this task. Do not touch commercial Settlement/Payout policies or PERF-CRIT-001.
PASS only if source-grounded gap + accurate two-seller two-different-promises wireframe + short implementation plan are complete. This PASS is DESIGN ONLY, not UI acceptance. STOP_FOR_ARCHITECT, await user approval of WIREFRAME before disruptive UI changes.
END_TOOBA_TASK
